items.name: Capacities
items.summary: Define capacities to pre-allocate for child data or data buffers.

items.name: MutableArrayData
items.summary: Efficiently create an [ArrayData] from one or more existing [ArrayData]s by copying chunks.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend(&mut self, index: usize, start: usize, end: usize)
methods.summary: Extends the in progress array with a region of the input arrays.

methods.name: extend_nulls
methods.summary: Extends the in progress array with null elements, ignoring the input arrays.

methods.name: freeze
methods.summary: Creates a [ArrayData] from the in progress array, consuming `self`.

methods.name: into_builder
methods.summary: Consume self and returns the in progress array as [`ArrayDataBuilder`].

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(arrays: Vec<&'a ArrayData>, use_nulls: bool, capacity: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a new [MutableArrayData] with capacity to `capacity` slots and specialized to create an [ArrayData] from multiple `arrays`.

methods.name: try_extend
methods.signature: fn try_extend(&mut self, index: usize, start: usize, end: usize) -> Result<(), ArrowError>
methods.summary: Extends the in progress array with a region of the input arrays, returning an error on overflow.

methods.name: try_extend_nulls
methods.signature: fn try_extend_nulls(&mut self, len: usize) -> Result<(), ArrowError>
methods.summary: Extends the in progress array with null elements, ignoring the input arrays, returning an error on overflow.

methods.name: with_capacities
methods.signature: fn with_capacities(arrays: Vec<&'a ArrayData>, use_nulls: bool, capacities: Capacities) -> Self
methods.summary: Similar to [MutableArrayData::new], but lets users define the preallocated capacities of the array with more granularity.
